criteria.criterion: The footer has a top border using var(--border-hairline) as the width and var(--border-subtle) as the color, and no other decoration (no background, box-shadow, or border-radius).
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 126-130: `.site-footer { margin-top: var(--control-px-lg); padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: var(--border-hairline) solid var(--border-subtle); }` — only border-top is set; no background, box-shadow, or border-radius property appears in the rule (verified by direct read of the file, evidence/qa2-app-diff.txt). evidence/qa2-css-cascade-check.txt confirms no pre-existing `footer` element selector exists elsewhere in styles.css that could add conflicting decoration.

criteria.criterion: The footer's text is styled with font-size: var(--text-caption) and font-weight: var(--weight-regular), and no other font-size or font-weight rule applies to it.
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 132-135: `.site-footer .caption { font-size: var(--text-caption); font-weight: var(--weight-regular); }`. evidence/qa2-css-cascade-check.txt: grep for `^footer|^p |^p{|^p,|body {` in styles.css finds only the `body {}` rule, which sets font-family/background/color/padding — no font-size or font-weight — and no global `p` or `footer` selector exists. The universal `*` reset (styles.css line 40) sets only box-sizing and margin. No other rule in the file can apply font-size or font-weight to `.site-footer .caption`.

criteria.criterion: The footer's spacing (its margin above the rule and padding between the rule and the text) uses only token values already defined in apps/connect/styles.css's :root block (e.g. var(--space-3), var(--control-px-lg)) — no new pixel literals anywhere in the diff.
criteria.evidence: `.site-footer` uses margin-top: var(--control-px-lg) and padding-top: var(--space-3), both pre-existing :root entries (styles.css lines 16 and 24). evidence/qa2-app-diff.txt shows every added line across both files; none contains a raw pixel literal, hex value, or inline font-family string — only var(--...) references and markup.
